data.name: Corner Wars
data.detailed_description:
Corner Wars

Build your defense. Send creeps. Outlast your opponents.

Corner Wars is a competitive tower defense game that goes wherever you go. The game runs discreetly in the corner of your screen and is perfect for playing alongside whatever you're doing—whether you're working, streaming, watching videos, or playing other games.

Build powerful towers, create your own custom deck, and send increasingly powerful creeps to pressure your opponents. Every decision matters.

Try the free demo and let us know what you think! Join our Discord, share your feedback, or take a look at the latest ideas from our artist.

We wanted a normal tower. He drew an egg. Now it's in the game.

Build Your Defense

Hold back incoming waves and find the perfect balance between economy, expansion, and defense.

  • Numerous unique Towers

  • Different strategies and synergies

  • Easy to learn, hard to master

Send Creeps

Use your resources wisely and overwhelm your opponents' defenses.

  • Various Send cards

  • Strategic timing is key

  • Manage offense and defense at the same time

Create Your Deck

Choose from a growing collection of cards and develop your own playstyle.

  • Unlockable cards

  • Unique deck combinations

  • New strategies every match

Multiplayer for up to 4 Players

Challenge other players and fight your way to the top.

  • Matches for up to 4 players

  • Global leaderboards

  • Seasonal rewards

Singleplayer & Dungeons

Improve your skills and take on special challenges.

  • Dungeon challenges

  • Test new strategies

  • Optimize cards and builds

Progression & Rewards

Expand your arsenal with every match.

  • Card upgrades

  • Unlockable skins

  • Loot crates and rewards

The Return of a Classic

Inspired by the legendary Tower Wars custom games of the past, Corner Wars combines classic line tower defense with modern deckbuilding mechanics, long-term progression, and fast, flexible matches.

Defend your lane. Send creeps. Adapt your strategy.

Easy to learn. Hard to master. Always ready for one more match.
